questions.question: While King Saul waited seven days at Gilgal for Samuel to come, what began to happen to his troops?

answers.text: They began to demand a new king
They began to march on Michmash

questions.question: Samuel told King Saul that if he had kept the LORD's command, the LORD would have established his kingdom over Israel for all time. True or false?
After Saul offered the burnt offering himself, what kind of man did Samuel say the LORD had sought to rule His people?

answers.text: A man after His own heart
A man from Saul's own house

questions.question: On the day Israel's army under King Saul faced the Philistines in battle, who had a sword or spear?

answers.text: All six hundred of the men
